يحتبسون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَبِسُونَ (yaḥtabisūna) /jaħ.ta.bi.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# يُحْتَبَسُونَ (yuḥtabasūna) /juħ.ta.ba.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
